components.css: .ds-primary{display:inline-flex;min-height:2.875rem;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:.65rem 1.25rem;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:999px;font:600 .875rem var(--font-geist,sans-serif);transition:transform 180ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1),box-shadow 500ms ease;background:var(--action-hot-pink,#ff4fb8);color:var(--action-ink,#271333);box-shadow:0 0 25px color-mix(in srgb,var(--action-glow,#b43dff) 48%,transparent)}.ds-primary:hover{box-shadow:0 0 5px var(--action-glow,#b43dff),0 0 25px var(--action-glow,#b43dff),0 0 50px color-mix(in srgb,var(--action-glow,#b43dff) 75%,transparent),0 0 100px color-mix(in srgb,var(--action-glow,#b43dff) 48%,transparent)}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#edce82);outline-offset:5px}.ds-primary:active{transform:scale(.97)}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-primary{transition:none}.ds-primary:active{transform:none}}
